skills.name: find-leads
skills.description: End-to-end lead prospecting with SalesQL. Research a business's ideal customer profile (ICP), translate it into SalesQL search filters, find matching people, and reveal verified emails and phone numbers. Use this whenever the user wants to find leads, prospects, potential customers, or contacts for a business — even if they only give a company description, a website URL, or a vague ask like "who should I sell this to?". Also use it when the user mentions ICP research, building a lead list, or filling a pipeline.
headings: Step 4 — Present the shortlist and get approval
